ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High. Approximate 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform high-intensity (white) zone across the primary fluke body. Low-intensity (black) pixels form a narrow continuous boundary along the trailing edge and dense clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and a vertical depth of ~12% relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations (2-4 pixel amplitude) along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to macro-serrations and jagged protrusions (10+ pixel amplitude) at the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct rough-textured clusters at both distal tips. Several circular, low-contrast indentations visible on the surface of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustations (likely barnacles) concentrated on the distal lobe tips, altering the smooth geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Predominantly white pigmentation (Type 1 fluke) with minimal internal mottling.
